name: Heimdall
subtitle: Bifrost Warden
description: Defend the bifrost against marauding invaders and protect the halls of asgard from harm!
lore: The sentinel of Bifrost, Heimdall has long guarded Asgard against danger—yet now the entire world is a threat. He does not know how the Shattering could have happened without him spotting some warning, some trace. That lack of understanding, and what he views as a failure of his duties, spur him to new efforts that may exhaust even his divine endurance.
divinity_generator: Gain [40] Divinity when hit by an enemy.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: DMG Reduction Multiplier +20%, Ignore RES +20%, Shield Multiplier +30%
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%
Awaken the ability: Shield of Asgard

skills.name: Bifrost Blade
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy (190%DEF+120%ATK) and transfer a random [Debuff] from this hero to the target. If [mechanic:blaze], [mechanic:aetherburn], or [mechanic:acid] is transferred, activate the [Debuff] after attacking.

skills.name: Watchmaster
skills.description: Place [mechanic:retaliate] and [mechanic:intercept] on all allies for 2 turns, then attack all enemies (270%DEF+140%ATK).
skills.awakening_bonus: Also places [Ward] on this hero for 2 turns, which cannot be removed.

skills.name: Shield of Asgard
skills.description: Place [mechanic:def-up-ii] on all allies for 2 turns, and place [mechanic:shield]300%DEF on all allies. Then place [mechanic:protect-ii] on all allies except this hero for 2 turns. These buffs cannot be removed when placed on heroes from Asgard.
skills.awakening_bonus: At the start of each wave, activate this ultimate before any turn is taken.

skills.name: Vanguard's Vigil
skills.description: Allies under any [Buff] have a 50% chance to [mechanic:reflect] any [Debuff] received.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also heals this hero 3%HP whenever a [Debuff] is reflected.

imprint_passive: If this hero is under a [Buff] has a 25% chance to reflect any [Debuff] received.
